Theropod_Vestigial_Forelimbs.description: Withered and largely vestigial, the tiny forelimbs of the theropod barely resemble true arms, their atrophied muscles and stunted digits serving more to balance and grasp than to wield weapons, subtly enhancing agility at the cost of raw strength.

Raptor_Slashing_Talons.description: With razor-sharp talons that slice through air and flesh alike, these elongated, curved claws are a deadly extension of the saurian arms, enhancing the wielder's dexterity and agility to perform swift and lethal strikes that cause bleeding over time, while also granting the ability to scale sheer surfaces with prehensile grace.

Triceratops_Stout_Forelegs.description: Bulging with sinew and muscle, the Triceratops' stout forelegs are marvels of sheer power and resilience, their thick, scaly hide offering an extra layer of protection while their immense strength grants the quadruped the ability to knock down even the largest of foes and block incoming attacks with ease.

Spinosaurus_Clawed_Hooks.description: Equipped with these formidable Spinosaurus Clawed Hooks, your arms transform into powerful, elongated appendages, perfect for grappling prey or slicing through enemies with ease. The sharp, serrated claws not only enhance your reach and strength, but also grant you the ability to swim at incredible speeds and cause bleeding with every strike.

Chameleon_Grasping_Paws.description: Equipped with elongated, prehensile limbs that unfurl and grip with the precision of a predator, these saurian grasping paws grant unparalleled dexterity and agility, allowing for effortless scaling of sheer surfaces and rapid manipulation of objects in the blink of an eye.

Pterosaur_Winged_Forelimbs.description: Equipped with leathery wings and sharp claws, these saurian forelimbs grant unparalleled agility and dexterity, enabling swift gliding maneuvers and nimble climbing through treacherous terrain, while the innate skill of aerobatics allows for intricate aerial combat and evasion.

Stegosaurus_Plated_Forelegs.description: The stegosaurus plated forelegs are formidable, their thick, bony plates interwoven with sinew to create a natural armor that deflects blows with ease, while their powerful muscles amplify the creature’s strength, allowing it to block attacks and resist being knocked down.

Crocodilian_Webbed_Claws.description: Equipped with razor-sharp, webbed claws, this Saurian appendage enhances both terrestrial and aquatic prowess, boosting raw strength and agility, while granting the mastery of swift underwater dashes and formidable grappling attacks.

Spectral_Saurian_Ghost_Limbs.description: Emerging from the void, the Spectral Saurian Ghost Limbs are haunting appendages that hover and stretch, granting their possessor a formidable reach and an ethereal touch imbued with the arcane, allowing them to detect and exploit magical energies.

Zombie_Trex_Rotting_Stumps.description: The Zombie_Trex_Rotting_Stumps, a towering undead relic of prehistoric might, drags its skeletal limbs through the mire, its once-massive arms now barely more than crumbling stumps, yet its consciousness remains a twisted echo, granting it an eerie resilience against the toxins that would otherwise claim it.
